# Keep contact browser-test filenames in their local behavior family

browser_contact_sidebar_keyboard.js is registered beside browser_contact_sidebar.js in the current browser.toml. The behavior qualifier uses an underscore suffix. Other inspected composition files use stems such as browser_emlActions.js and browser_imageDisplay.js. Follow the sibling test family when adding a scenario file; this evidence supports the address-book sidebar spelling, not a repository-wide conversion of all test stems.

Scope: mail/components/addrbook.
